decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west  walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights shall be installed to be flush with the existing roof slope and have a 'conservation style' with a central mullion.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a ground floor rear and side extension to the house
